

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(forecast)
library(ggplot2)

```

```{r}
load_raw <- read_excel("load.xlsx")
temp_raw <- read_excel("temperature.xlsx")
rh_raw   <- read_excel("relative_humidity.xlsx")
sub_template <- read.csv("submission_template.csv")
```


```{r}
glimpse(load_raw)
glimpse(temp_raw)
glimpse(rh_raw)
```


```{r}
names(load_raw)
names(temp_raw)
names(rh_raw)

head(load_raw)
head(temp_raw)
head(rh_raw)

```



```{r}
## transfer load to daily
load_daily <- load_raw %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  mutate(
    load_daily = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("h")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(date, load_daily)
```

```{r}
## transfer temp to daily
temp_daily <- temp_raw %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  mutate(
    temp_hourly_avg = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("t_ws")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    temp_daily = mean(temp_hourly_avg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
## transfer humidity to daily
rh_daily <- rh_raw %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  mutate(
    rh_hourly_avg = rowMeans(select(., starts_with("rh_ws")), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    rh_daily = mean(rh_hourly_avg, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
## combine daily data
daily_data <- load_daily %>%
  left_join(temp_daily, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(rh_daily, by = "date")

glimpse(daily_data)
head(daily_data)
summary(daily_data)
colSums(is.na(daily_data))
```


```{r}
## split train and validation data
 train_data <- daily_data %>%
  filter(date <= as.Date("2010-06-30"))

valid_data <- daily_data %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("2010-07-01") &
         date <= as.Date("2010-07-31"))
```

```{r}
 # create time series
train_ts <- ts(train_data$load_daily, frequency = 7)

# seasonal naive forecast for validation period
fc_snaive <- snaive(train_ts, h = nrow(valid_data))

# accuracy
accuracy(fc_snaive, valid_data$load_daily)

# plot actual vs forecast on validation dates
validation_results <- data.frame(
  date = valid_data$date,
  actual = valid_data$load_daily,
  forecast = as.numeric(fc_snaive$mean)
)

ggplot(validation_results, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual, color = "Actual"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = forecast, color = "Forecast"), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal Naive: Validation Forecast vs Actual",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Daily Load",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
 # use all available historical data up to 2011-06-30
full_data <- daily_data %>%
  filter(date >= as.Date("2005-01-01"),
         date <= as.Date("2011-06-30")) %>%
  arrange(date)

# create weekly seasonal time series
full_ts <- ts(full_data$load_daily, frequency = 7)

# fit seasonal naive model and forecast for the submission horizon
final_fc <- snaive(full_ts, h = nrow(sub_template))

# create final submission file in the same format as the template
submission <- sub_template %>%
  mutate(load = as.numeric(final_fc$mean))

# quick checks
head(submission)
tail(submission)
sum(is.na(submission$load))
nrow(submission)

# save csv
write.csv(submission, "submission_snaive.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
